evidence: The films were grown on glass, fused silica and silicon substrates. The maximum size of the glass substrates was 30 mm x 60 mm, whereas the typical sizes of the silica and silicon substrates were 30 mm x 40 mm and 10 mm x 10 mm respectively. The glass substrates were placed at 60 mm and the silica and silicon substrates at 80 mm distances from the gas inlets. N, was used as carrier gas at a pressure of 250 Pa at the reactor outlet.
